svg.text: ResumeOS scoring algorithm v3 — final flowchart

g.text: Layer 1: Will your resume be FOUND? (ATS ranking)
Simulates: recruiter types "[job title] [key skill] [industry]" into ATS
Does your resume surface? Checks exact title match + top 3 JD skills
= sum(matched keyword tier weight × placement multiplier) / sum(all keyword weights)
Layer 2: Will a recruiter SHORTLIST you? (human eval)
Edit recommendation engine — what should you change?
Edit prioritization — sorted by expected impact
1. Preserve original metrics and numbers from the bullet
2. Max 2 new keywords per rewrite (no keyword stuffing)
3. Must cite source: projectContext or repo variant used
4. "6-second test": reads natural to a scanning recruiter
5. Keywords in context with achievements, not just listed
Re-score — full AI analysis on updated resume
Score drops → edit was bad → user can undo
Score improves → edit worked → proceed to export
Deterministic preview instant, AI is the final authority
ATS doesn't reject — it ranks. Recruiters review the top 20 out of 200+.
Our job: rank top 20, then impress in 6 seconds of human scanning.
What makes this different from Jobscan / generic checkers
Edits draw from YOUR real experience repo + projectContext.
Never invents — only reframes what you actually did.
